units: <cite ref="Chullin 110a:6">Ḥull. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>תבשילא דכחלא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>דכחל</he>) a dish made of udder.—Pl. <cite ref="K00467"><he>כַּחֲלֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 110a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>בסורא … כ׳</he> in Sura they do not eat udders.
<cite ref="Chullin 110a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>אפקינהו כ״ע לכַחְלַיְיהוּ</he> (not <he>לכחלינהו</he>) all of them brought out the udders they were about to cook.
